main_text.p: כַּשִּׁיל Chal. Securis, bipennis, ut Hebr. Plur. בַּשִּׁילִין Jer. 46. 22.
בְּשַׁף Pihel Hebr. Præstigiis uti. Syriac. in Etpah.
ܒܫܩܠ Orare, obsecrare, precari, preces fundere, supplicare.
ܒܥܝܠ Syr. Supplicatio, Preces, ad Hebr. 5. 7.
כּוּשְׁפִּין Ch. Arcæ, arculæ, scrinia, Ezech.27.24.

כְּשַׁר Ch. Rectum esse vel videri, congruere, decere, conveniens esse. Ithpah. אִתְכְּשַׁר Rectificari: Rectum esse. Ex Aphel, לָא אַכְשְׁרוּ יָתִי Pro recto, digno, idoneo nondum habuerunt me, 1. Sam. 17. 8.
וַאַכְשְׁרְתָּנִי Et dignam fecisti me, Ruth. 2. 13.
כְּשַׁר, כְּשָׁר Ch. Rectus, rectum. Fœm. כְּשִׁירָא emp. כְּשִׁירְתָּא Recta.

כְּשִׁרָא Ch. Scutum, Sclypeus וְחוּסְרָנָךְ הֵיךְ גִּבְרָא כְּשִׁרָא Et egestas tua sicut vir clypei, clypeo armatus, Prov.6. 11. Si modò idem est quod Hebr. אִישׁ מָגֵן cui respondet. Regia habent, Vir rectus.
כְּשׁוּרָא, כְּשׁוּר Ch. Trabs, tignum. Plu. כְּשׁוּרִין Deu. 1. 19. in Jon.
כְּשַׁרְתָּא Ch. Onyx, species aromatis, quæ ad suffitum adhibebatur, Heb. שְׁחֵלֶת Exod.30.34. in Jonath.
כְּתֵב Ch. & Syr. Scribere, conscribere, describere, perscribere. Ithpehal אִתְכְּתֵב & per Syncopam אִכְתִיב

page.notes: Hebrew, Chaldee and Syriac words are reproduced from the scan at reduced fidelity; the vowel points and exact letter forms of the Hebrew, Syriac and Chaldee words are uncertain and should be checked against the original. Faint show-through from the reverse page is not transcribed.
